test_title: PYST 2: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

__Despite of__ his persistent efforts, the proposal was rejected.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Despite his persistence**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The phrase "**Despite of**" is incorrect in standard English usage. The correct form is simply "**Despite**."
 
• The correct replacement "**Despite his persistence**" correctly conveys the intended meaning.
 
• **Options 2, 3, and 4** are grammatically incorrect due to the improper use of prepositions or incorrect sentence construction.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"Despite his persistence, the proposal was rejected."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "Though of his persistence"** is incorrect because "Though" cannot be followed by "of."
 
• **Option 3: "Although his persistent"** is incorrect because "persistent" is an adjective and does not fit here grammatically.
 
• **Option 4: "In spite his persistence"** is incorrect because it lacks the preposition "of" after "In spite."
